en.headline: Woman dies after being pulled from harbour off Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: Police said a woman of about 30 was found in the water near K11 on Saturday morning and was pronounced dead at Queen Elizabeth Hospital.
body: A woman died on Saturday morning after she was pulled from Victoria Harbour off Tsim Sha Tsui, police said.

Officers received a report at about 6:59am that a person was in the water off 18 Salisbury Road, near K11 MUSEA and the Avenue of Stars. Firefighters and a rescue boat recovered a woman of about 30. She was unconscious when brought ashore and was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital, where she was pronounced dead at 7:31am, according to reports of the police account.

Police said the case was being treated as a drowning. Officers were trying to confirm her identity and to establish how she entered the water, and were reviewing closed-circuit footage along the promenade. A bag and other belongings found near a small pier were being examined as possible possessions of the woman. No name has been released.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀海傍女子被救起後不治
zh.dek: 警方指一名約30歲女子周六清晨在K11對開海面被發現，送伊利沙伯醫院後於早上7時31分證實死亡。
body: 尖沙咀海傍周六清晨有人墮海，一名女子被救起後不治。警方正調查事件。
警方在早上約6時59分接報，指梳士巴利道18號、近K11 MUSEA及星光大道對開海面有人載浮載沉。消防及救援船到場，救起一名約30歲女子。她上岸時昏迷，由救護車送往伊利沙伯醫院，至早上7時31分證實死亡。
警方將案件暫列有人遇溺，正確認死者身份及了解她如何墮海，並翻查海濱一帶閉路電視。人員在附近小型碼頭發現一個手袋及其他物品，正查證是否屬於死者。當局暫未公布姓名。
